main_chase_cards.name: Chikorita
main_chase_cards.why: The Grass first partner gives the trio its gentle opening and is the cleanest way to see WHF 2000 as Johto launch-era public memory rather than just another Chikorita print.

main_chase_cards.name: Cyndaquil
main_chase_cards.why: The Fire starter is the emotional spark of the WHF trio; it needs route discipline because Champion Road and regular Neo Genesis memories sit so close.

main_chase_cards.name: Totodile
main_chase_cards.why: The Water starter completes the public-facing Johto trio and is especially vulnerable to being flattened into ordinary Totodile nostalgia unless the WHF route is preserved.

key_artists.name: Naoyo Kimura
key_artists.why: Kimura's Chikorita credit gives the WHF set its soft first note: an approachable Johto starter carrying event-route memory.

key_artists.name: Shin-ichi Yoshida
key_artists.why: Yoshida's Cyndaquil credit keeps the fire starter's early TCG personality attached to this specific WHF print lane.

key_artists.name: Hironobu Yoshida
key_artists.why: Yoshida's Totodile credit gives the trio its kinetic final bite: a Water starter print that should stay pinned to WHF rather than generic starter nostalgia.

claims.text: The local release groups Bulbapedia raw source rows 148-150 under the promotion note World Hobby Fair 2000 commemoration card.

The modeled group contains the three Johto first partners Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile as contiguous rows 148-150; it should not silently absorb Champion Road rows 151-153 or adjacent Berry / Miracle Berry rows.
PokeBoon's card pages for Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile each list Distribution Date: January 9, 2000 for the World Hobby Fair 2000 commemoration card.
PokeBoon credits the WHF trio to Naoyo Kimura for Chikorita, Shin-ichi Yoshida for Cyndaquil, and Hironobu Yoshida for Totodile.

This source group matters because it turns the three Johto first partners into public event-memory at the start of the Gold/Silver era, where a familiar starter trio needs tiny route markers to remain historically legible.

Agents should preserve source rows 148-150, WHF 2000 commemoration route, PokeBoon distribution-date witness, card-specific artist credits, and non-equivalence with Champion Road, regular Neo Genesis, Premium File, jumbo first-partner cards, or generic Johto-starter listings before accepting a match.

narrative.human_title: World Hobby Fair 2000 — Johto's first partners step into public
narrative.why_it_matters: This trio is small but culturally loud. Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile are the first partners of a new region, and here they show up as a World Hobby Fair memory right as Gold and Silver were turning Pokemon into a second-generation machine. The cards are not rare because the characters are obscure; they matter because the route is so easy to blur. WHF, Champion Road, Neo Genesis, Premium File: all of them can look like Johto nostalgia until an agent keeps the assembly straight.
